abstract: Mature cystic teratoma of the fallopian tube is extremely rare, with no reports existing on infertility treatment following its surgical removal. We report a case of mature cystic teratoma identified within the right fallopian tube during laparoscopic surgery, with only the tumor resected while preserving the tube. Three-month postoperative hysterosalpingography showed preserved tubal patency, but contrast agent retention in the pelvic cavity was noted during the delayed phase, suggesting peritubal adhesions. Subsequent timed intercourse failed to result in pregnancy, leading to in vitro fertilization. Laparoscopy prior to embryo transfer confirmed hydrosalpinx, prompting right salpingectomy. Clinical pregnancy was achieved following frozen-thawed blastocyst transfer performed 2 months postoperatively. The pregnancy progressed well and resulted in delivery at term. Even when tubal preservation is chosen for mature cystic tubal teratoma, normal tubal function may not necessarily be maintained. Therefore, early postoperative hysterosalpingography and prompt laparoscopic evaluation with appropriate surgical intervention if abnormalities are detected are useful for improving subsequent infertility treatment outcomes.
abstract_ja: 卵管の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は極めて稀であり、その外科的切除後の不妊治療に関する報告は存在しない。われわれは、腹腔鏡手術中に右卵管内に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を認めた症例を報告する。腫瘍のみを切除し卵管を温存した。術後3か月の子宮卵管造影では卵管の開通は保たれていたが、遅延相で骨盤腔内への造影剤の貯留が認められ、卵管周囲癒着が示唆された。その後のタイミング性交では妊娠に至らず、体外受精を行った。胚移植前の腹腔鏡検査で水卵管症が確認され、右卵管摘除術を行った。術後2か月に凍結融解胚盤胞移植を行い、臨床的妊娠が成立した。妊娠経過は良好で、正期産で出産に至った。成熟嚢胞性卵管奇形腫に対して卵管温存を選択しても、正常な卵管機能が必ずしも維持されるとは限らない。したがって、術後早期の子宮卵管造影と、異常を認めた場合の速やかな腹腔鏡評価および適切な外科的介入は、その後の不妊治療の成績向上に有用である。
